name: Talk Audio Cleanup
summary: Clean the sound of a talking Draft the way a broadcast editing guide asks, by rules whose thresholds you set: cut clicks out of the pauses, lower breaths and fade every cut by one frame, on a copy of the Draft.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript and runShell, selects.media.startFFmpeg and measureAudioPeaks, selects.files.readRange and writeChunk, Project createDraft and duplicateDraft, and Draft insertResource, remove, splitAt and setClipAudio. Where the app accepts a one-frame audio crossfade placed after a cut (applyTransitionPreset with placement), fades are placed as that transition; otherwise as the next clip's fade-in. The analysis is a Python program run through the shell, so Windows and web are not supported.

de.name: Sprach-Audio-Bereinigung
de.summary: Bereinigt den Ton eines Sprach-Drafts nach einem Schnittleitfaden aus dem Rundfunk, mit Regeln, deren Schwellen Sie selbst einstellen: schneidet Klicks aus den Pausen, senkt Atemgeräusche ab und blendet jeden Schnitt um einen Frame ein – auf einer Kopie des Drafts.

en.name: Talk Audio Cleanup
en.summary: Clean the sound of a talking Draft the way a broadcast editing guide asks, by rules whose thresholds you set: cut clicks out of the pauses, lower breaths and fade every cut by one frame, on a copy of the Draft.

es.name: Limpieza de audio de voz
es.summary: Limpia el sonido de un Draft hablado como pide una guía de edición de radiodifusión, con reglas cuyos umbrales ajustas tú: corta los clics de las pausas, baja las respiraciones y aplica un fundido de un fotograma en cada corte, sobre una copia del Draft.

fr.name: Nettoyage audio de la voix
fr.summary: Nettoie le son d’un Draft parlé comme le demande un guide de montage audiovisuel, avec des règles dont vous réglez les seuils : coupe les clics dans les pauses, baisse les respirations et applique un fondu d’une image à chaque coupe, sur une copie du Draft.

it.name: Pulizia audio del parlato
it.summary: Pulisce l’audio di un Draft parlato come richiede una guida di montaggio televisivo, con regole di cui imposti tu le soglie: taglia i clic nelle pause, abbassa i respiri e applica una dissolvenza di un fotogramma a ogni taglio, su una copia del Draft.

ja.name: トーク音声クリーンアップ
ja.summary: 放送の編集ガイドに沿ってトークのDraftの音を整えます。基準は自分で調整できるルールです。間のクリック音をカットし、息を下げ、カットごとに1フレームのフェードを入れて、Draftのコピーを作ります。

ko.name: 토크 오디오 정리
ko.summary: 방송 편집 가이드대로 말하는 영상의 소리를 정리합니다. 기준은 직접 조절하는 규칙입니다. 틈 사이 딸깍을 잘라내고, 숨소리를 낮추고, 자른 자리마다 1프레임 Fade를 넣어 Draft 사본을 만듭니다.

pt.name: Limpeza de áudio de fala
pt.summary: Limpa o som de um Draft falado como pede um guia de edição de radiodifusão, com regras cujos limiares você ajusta: corta os cliques das pausas, baixa as respirações e aplica um fade de um quadro em cada corte, numa cópia do Draft.

tr.name: Konuşma Sesi Temizleme
tr.summary: Konuşma içeren bir Draft’ın sesini bir yayın kurgu kılavuzunun istediği gibi, eşiklerini sizin ayarladığınız kurallarla temizler: duraklamalardaki tıklamaları keser, nefesleri kısar ve her kesime bir karelik geçiş ekler; Draft’ın bir kopyası üzerinde çalışır.

zh.name: 访谈音频清理
zh.summary: 按广播剪辑规范清理谈话类 Draft 的声音，规则的阈值由你调整：剪掉停顿中的哒声，降低呼吸声，并在每个剪切点加入一帧淡入，结果保存为 Draft 的副本。
